description: Land Commissioner General's Department - Mrs. S. G. K. M. K. Abesinghe is appointed as a Land Officer for District of Badulla and Monaragala
categorisation: This gazette notification is primarily about the appointment of a Land Officer for specific districts under the Land Development Ordinance. The content focuses on land administration matters (appointing an officer for land-related duties in Badulla and Monaragala districts) and comes from the Land Commissioner General's Department. This fits Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land and property-related administrative matters rather than general government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
